# `court_opinion_bodies`

One row per *opinion* — a single voice within a decision (majority, concurrence, dissent), each with its own author and its own text — ingested from the bulk `opinions` dump by `build_court_opinion_bodies`. `cluster_id` joins `court_opinion_clusters`, and through it `court_dockets`. This is the table the `court-opinion-v1` profile had been forward-declaring: `plain_text` and `html_with_citations` are CourtListener opinion fields that no published table carried until this ingest. **Coverage is partial by construction and the bound is recorded, not implied.** The 2026-06-30 `opinions` dump is 50.8 GiB compressed (~422 GiB decompressed) and streams at roughly 1.8 MiB/s, so a full pass is about 8.6 hours and landing it would breach the project's 100 GiB free-space floor; scheduled runs therefore take a bounded slice. See `docs/evidence/court-data-coverage.md` for the exact row counts, id ranges, and named gaps. Primary / dedup key is `opinion_id`. All columns are stored as VARCHAR.

- **Parquet file:** `court_opinion_bodies.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opinion_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener opinion id. Primary key / dedup key. |
| `cluster_id` | `VARCHAR` | Decision this opinion belongs to. Joins `court_opinion_clusters.cluster_id`. |
| `opinion_type` | `VARCHAR` | Opinion role within the decision, for example `010combined`, `020lead`, `030concurrence`, `040dissent`. |
| `author_str` | `VARCHAR` | Authoring judge's name as published, when supplied. |
| `author_id` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener people-database id of the authoring judge, when resolved. |
| `joined_by_str` | `VARCHAR` | Judges who joined this opinion, as a publisher-supplied string. |
| `per_curiam` | `VARCHAR` | `t` when the opinion was issued per curiam. |
| `sha1` | `VARCHAR` | CourtListener's SHA-1 of the source document it ingested. |
| `page_count` | `VARCHAR` | Page count of the source document, when known. |
| `download_url` | `VARCHAR` | Original court-website URL the opinion was downloaded from. |
| `local_path` | `VARCHAR` | Path to the archived source file in CourtListener's public storage bucket. |
| `extracted_by_ocr` | `VARCHAR` | `t` when the text was produced by OCR rather than embedded extraction. |
| `plain_text` | `VARCHAR` | Plain-text body of the opinion as published by CourtListener. Frequently null when the upstream source supplied only a markup rendering — check `available_text_fields` before treating null as missing. |
| `html_with_citations` | `VARCHAR` | HTML body with citations marked up as links, as published by CourtListener. |
| `available_text_fields` | `VARCHAR` | Comma-separated names of the dump's body columns that were non-empty for this row (`plain_text`, `html`, `html_lawbox`, `html_columbia`, `html_anon_2020`, `html_with_citations`, `xml_harvard`, `xml_scan`). Records which rendering the publisher actually held, so an empty `plain_text` is distinguishable from an opinion with no text at all. |
| `text_char_count` | `VARCHAR` | Character length of the longest available body rendering, as a decimal string. Zero means the publisher holds no text for this opinion. |
| `date_created` | `VARCHAR` | Timestamp CourtListener first created the opinion record. |
| `date_modified` | `VARCHAR` | Timestamp the opinion record was last modified upstream. |
| `dump_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date stamp of the bulk dump this row was read from, for example `2026-06-30`. |
